def VTask.binaryRec {motive : ℕ → Sort u} (zero : motive 0) (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) (n : ℕ) : motive n :=
  Nat.strong_induction_on n fun n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => zero
    | n + 1 =>
      have h : (n + 1) = Nat.bit ((n + 1) % 2 = 1) ((n + 1) / 2) := by
        have h₁ : (n + 1) % 2 = 1 ∨ (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
        cases h₁ with
        | inl h₁ =>
          -- Case: (n + 1) % 2 = 1
          have h₂ : (n + 1) = 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) + 1 := by
            have h₃ := Nat.div_add_mod (n + 1) 2
            omega
          rw [h₂]
          simp [Nat.bit, h₁]
          <;> ring_nf at *
          <;> omega
        | inr h₁ =>
          -- Case: (n + 1) % 2 = 0
          have h₂ : (n + 1) = 2 * ((n + 1) / 2) := by
            have h₃ := Nat.div_add_mod (n + 1) 2
            omega
          rw [h₂]
          simp [Nat.bit, h₁]
          <;> ring_nf at *
          <;> omega
      rw [h]
      apply bit ((n + 1) % 2 = 1) ((n + 1) / 2)
      apply ih ((n + 1) / 2)
      <;> omega
